_comment: Live images: shown from each institution's own server, never copied into this repository. Turn a source on only when its terms allow it or its permission is confirmed; keep written confirmations on file.

ashmolean.basis: Permission confirmed by the project owner, 21 Sep 2026 (Ashmolean Picture Library).

rubin.basis: Rubin website terms allow limited non-commercial, educational use with citation of source and www.rubinmuseum.org (checked 21 Sep 2026).

joconde.basis: Permission from the Joconde museums' rights holders confirmed by the project owner, 21 Sep 2026 (all 39 photos). Records marked DIFFU=non remain excluded.

guimet.basis: Permission from Guimet / RMN-Grand Palais confirmed by the project owner, 21 Sep 2026.
